logic_errors.trigger: Render timing runs at niter=150000 together with legacy or niter=20000 trace runs.
logic_errors.issue: The figure-wide iteration label validates only timing['runs'], although the copy-accounting panel uses trace['runs']. Mixed-budget data therefore renders successfully under a misleading single-budget title. Overlap runs also bypass iteration validation.
logic_errors.fix: Validate iteration metadata for every plotted phase before producing output. Reject incompatible budgets or explicitly label each panel's budget, including unknown legacy metadata.

suggestions: Add lightweight mocked-render coverage for cross-phase budget mismatches and legacy/current mixtures; current tests exercise iteration_label only in isolation.
summary: Inspected all requested diffs, both test files, the launcher and plan, plus supporting runner/analyzer code. The 150000 default, explicit overrides, pre-write iteration validation, receipts, and bounded monitoring windows are consistent; the core CLI is unchanged. No tests, rendering, builds, or benchmarks were executed; the reported 223 passing tests were not independently verified.
